claim: The dual-3090 TB3 eGPU pool on OCTO-L01 is a qualified 48 GB fabric in both throughput (per-card pinned) and capacity (layer-split) modes, at the phase results recorded below, measured 2026-08-27.

double-27b-both.note: two pinned instances, one per card; card gap ~8% = the 1410-vs-1200 lock gap

split-35b-a3b-q8.note: 39 GB MoE q8 layer-split; capacity mode faster than single-card dense

split-70b-r1.note: 43.7 GB of 48 GB in use; ~200 W/card, 61/56 C during run

gpu_identities.label: MSI
gpu_identities.lock_reason: cards.json coreLockCapMHz 1200 caps the host default mode's 1410; pending OP-2 repaste

gpu_identities.label: Dell-B
gpu_identities.lock_reason: host default mode 'decode' coreLock 1410, uncapped for this card

aggregate_root_rule: sha256 over the UTF-8 text formed by one line per manifest entry, '<relative-name><SPACE><sha256><LF>', entries sorted lexicographically by name

claims: the four phase results above, on this host, these two GPU UUIDs, at the stated effective core locks, with the stated ollama model manifests
throughput mode: 2.05x aggregate scaling with 98.5% per-card retention
capacity mode: dense 70B (43.7 GB resident) decodes at 18.1 tok/s across the TB3 boundary
the per-card medians are bound to card roles through UUID-pinned serve ports, not through nvidia-smi ordinals
non_claims: no cross-host or four-card (w01) claim - that is CLAUDE-11, blocked on OP-3
no thermal-envelope qualification of the MSI card beyond the 1200 cap - OP-2 remains open
no model-quality or benchmark-accuracy claim for the served models
no batching/concurrency claim beyond the measured one-request-per-instance pattern
no K3/observatory claim - this capsule is fabric plumbing only

IDENTITY INSTRUMENTATION GAP: the phase receipts carry no per-run UUID or clock telemetry. The identity binding is POLICY-level - the pinning table, the core-lock policy and the ollama manifest bytes all predate the first phase and are digest-bound, and the two UUIDs are attested present on the host - but nothing proves the serve processes listening during the phases were started by that launcher, or that gpu-mode.ps1 had been applied in the live session. A future run must emit per-run device telemetry to close this.

raw_evidence_custody.statement: Raw phase receipts (per-run walls, nvidia-smi occupancy lines), the bench driver, and the contemporaneous identity artifacts (serve pinning table, core-lock policy and card registry, ollama model manifests, device attestation) remain in the operator's private estate tree on OCTO-L01, off-repository. This capsule commits their digests, the allowlisted numeric results, and the aggregate root; the committed capsule is the citable closure artifact. Any future dispute reopens the raw artifacts against receipt_manifest_sha256.

single-27b-msi.note: baseline isolation: the second card must be unallocated during the run

verification_levels.CAPSULE_ONLY_VERIFIED: committed capsule authenticated (fields, manifest, aggregate root, denominator)
verification_levels.RAW_BYTES_VERIFIED: plus: every raw private evidence file rehashes to its manifest digest
verification_levels.RAW_SEMANTICS_VERIFIED: plus: GPU UUIDs, card roles (via UUID-pinned serve ports), effective core locks (via the committed min-rule over the host mode and card cap), ollama manifest digests, per-sample token counts, recomputed decode AND prefill medians for both streams, per-card medians, aggregate/scaling/retention, VRAM and terminal verdict are all reconstructed from raw artifact content and agree with the capsule; the only level that supports CLAUDE-5 repository closure

supersedes.why: The @2 capsule asserted GPU UUIDs, core locks and ollama manifest digests that no artifact in the evidence denominator supported, so those identity fields could be rewritten while all three verification levels still passed. @3 adds the contemporaneous pinning/lock/manifest artifacts to the denominator, digest-binds them, and derives every identity, workload and per-card statistic from them. No measured phase result changed.

double-27b-both.note: primary stream = MSI serve, secondary stream = Dell-B serve

split-35b-a3b-q8.note: unpinned fabric serve, layer-split across both cards

split-70b-r1.note: unpinned fabric serve, layer-split across both cards

identity_evidence.core_lock_host_mode_derivation: the unique mode in the host calibration whose note declares DEFAULT
identity_evidence.card_role_derivation: capsule role -> UUID -> the serve port that pins that UUID in the launcher -> the receipt stream the driver drove on that port. nvidia-smi ordinal indices are never used to assign a card role.
